AMD Vivado: source the script of Open Logic once. It reads the scoped constraints of olo_base_cc_reset, olo_base_cc_bits, olo_base_cc_simple, olo_base_reset_gen and olo_base_ram_sdp wherever the system uses them, also inside the cores. tools/vivado/all_constraints_amd.tcl would also read those of olo_intf_sync, which expect device pins at its input and stop the build (ERROR 18-513) where a block synchronises internal signals with it, as ofb_pa_gty does; a block that synchronises device pins declares its own false path for them.

compile.note: Clone with the submodule 3rdParty/en_cl_fix (git clone --recursive); compile_order.txt lists its files. 4.7.0-ft.5 adds olo_base_chunker and olo_axi_lite_decoder to 4.7.0-ft.2 (ft.3), fixes the error reporting of olo_axi_master_simple and the write word count of olo_axi_master_full (ft.4), and fixes the address of transfers that olo_axi_master_simple splits at AxiMaxBeats_g (ft.5); it changes no other source, so the cores verified with 4.7.0-ft.2, 4.7.0-ft.3 or 4.7.0-ft.4 use it unchanged. Of the cores only OpenRMAP uses olo_axi_master_simple.
